title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
summary: The ant works hard storing food all summer, while the grasshopper only sings. What happens to them when winter comes?
moral: Work and prepare early. And be willing to share with those in need.
pages: In the bright summer, the Grasshopper sang and played among the flowers. 'Life is beautiful!' he said. He had no time to think about tomorrow.
Meanwhile, the Ant was busy carrying seeds to its nest. 'Come and help gather food, Grasshopper,' it invited. 'Winter will come.' The Grasshopper just laughed, 'Relax, it is still a long way off!'
Day after day passed. The Ant kept working hard until its food store was full. The Grasshopper relaxed on a rock, singing and dancing, without gathering a single grain of food.
Then winter came. Snow fell and covered the whole forest, and there were no more leaves or seeds to eat. The Grasshopper shivered with cold and was very hungry.

With weak steps, the Grasshopper knocked on the door of the Ant's nest. 'Ant, please help me. I am hungry and cold.' The Ant said, 'Why did you not store food in summer?' The Grasshopper could only bow his head in shame.
The Ant sighed, then smiled. 'Come in. We have enough food to share.' The Grasshopper thanked him and promised not to be lazy again. They ate together in the warm nest.
When spring came, the Grasshopper helped the Ant gather seeds. He learned that hard work matters, and the Ant learned that sharing is a joy. The end.
